name: Sequoyah County, OK
findings: Sequoyah County has 62 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sequoyah County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sequoyah County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
